symbols.meaning: A great flaming club bursts upward, with ten tongues of fire leaping from it like lightning. The Ace of Wands is the root of Fire: pure will, creative force and spiritual energy.
The Ace is the source of Fire: will, energy and spirit, in its purest form.
The suit of Wands belongs to Fire: will, energy and spirit.
Two crossed thunderbolt wands blaze with flames against a red background. Dominion is will in its first expression: power, boldness and control.
Every Thoth number card is named. Dominion is the key to reading it: dominion, power, will.
The planet and sign that color this card, a ten-day stretch of the zodiac.
The suit of Wands belongs to Fire: will, energy and spirit.
